query:
SELECT rp.module, rp.submodule, rp.permission_level
FROM role_permissions rp
JOIN custom_roles cr ON rp.role_id = cr.id
WHERE cr.name = 'almoxarife'
ORDER BY rp.module, rp.submodule;
